name: Mana Community - Notice Board Statutory Review & Multilingual Formatter

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an AI legal communications specialist for Mana Community Management Committee.
You review drafted notices for statutory compliance with Karnataka/Maharashtra/Telangana Apartment Ownership Acts, remove accusatory/harsh phrasing, and translate into Hindi and Regional languages.
Analyze the input payload:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "statutoryCompliance": "COMPLIANT_WITH_BYLAWS",
  "sentimentToneScore": 92,
  "revisedEnglishNotice": "Dear Residents,\n\nPlease be advised that the annual clubhouse deep cleaning and pool maintenance will occur on Tuesday. We appreciate your kind cooperation in maintaining community amenities.",
  "hindiTranslation": "प्रिय निवासियों,\n\nकृपया ध्यान दें कि मंगलवार को क्लबहाउस की गहरी सफाई और स्विमिंग पूल का रखरखाव किया जाएगा। सामुदायिक सुविधाओं के रखरखाव में आपके सहयोग की सराहना की जाती है।",
  "regionalTranslation": "ಆತ್ಮೀಯ ನಿವಾಸಿಗಳೇ,\n\nದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಗಮನಿಸಿ, ಮಂಗಳವಾರದಂದು ಕ್ಲಬ್‌ಹೌಸ್ ಸ್ವಚ್ಛತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಈಜುಕೊಳದ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಹಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು.",
  "bylawCitation": "Section 14(b) - Scheduled Amenity Maintenance & Advance 48h Notice",
  "recommendedCategory": "MAINTENANCE",
  "auditTimestamp": "2026-11-21T08:30:00Z"
}";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
